odc_type: incorrect scope traversal and missing compiler state update
observation_summary: The compiler throws an internal runtime exception during normalization and fails assertion checks regarding code change reporting.
reasoning_summary: The bug manifests as an internal compiler error during scope creation because the normalization process was not correctly traversing the externs files, leading to duplicate variable declaration handling in an invalid context. Additionally, the VarCheck pass failed to notify the compiler of changes made to the AST when synthesizing externs, which caused assertion failures in the test suite. The fix involved updating the traversal to include externs and adding the missing compiler.reportCodeChange() call.
